effects.text: Activate every active turret's special ability via its Toolbelt action and choose "Optimized Activation".

system.description:
(1/Safe Rest) 1 Action. You can use 1 Toolbelt scrap to activate all active turrets' abilities. This does not destroy the turrets.

[A] The 1/Safe Rest use is a counter on this feature, tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] Use a turret's Toolbelt special and pick "Optimized Activation" in its dialog: the module spends this use and 1 Toolbelt scrap (Undo cards) and keeps the turret; in combat, other turrets' specials used the same turn ride along free and are not destroyed (outside combat, activate each turret with its own Optimized Activation or by hand).
